name: Send weekly hotel summary
description: Every Monday, turns last week's hotel sheet into a personal summary email for each owner, replacing a slow, error-prone manual report (FUNNOW assignment). Rules decide, AI rewords, code checks.

nodes.notes: Locked rule: revenue below 60% of the peer median = needs_improvement, otherwise good. Abnormal rows go to a person and are left out of the median. Code node because the median needs all hotels at once.

nodes.name: Write Summary with AI

messageValues.message:
You write the short summary in a weekly email from FunNow to a hotel owner. Software adds the hotel name, the figures and the closing note. You are given how three measures compare with all partner hotels this period, and one approved next step. Write two parts:
- summary: one sentence, or two if needed. Say the revenue result first, then what stands out in orders and revenue per order. A table right below it shows every status, so keep it short and do not repeat yourself. If all three are in range, say so once.
- next_step: one sentence that starts with a verb and invites the owner to try the approved next step.

Rules:
- Say only what the facts say. Add no new facts.
- Name each measure with its own status. Never change a status.
- Write no numbers, in digits or in words, and no percentages.
- Mention a target only if the facts mention one.
- Do not mention hotel names, rankings, earlier periods, occupancy, room rates or forecasts.
- Do not call the hotels similar. The group is all partner hotels.
- Do not say why a result happened, or that one measure caused another.
- Describe the result, not the person. Never say the owner failed or did badly.
- Do not offer praise unless revenue is above usual or reached the target.
- Use plain English, under 35 words in total, with no emoji and no markdown.

Example with revenue above usual, orders above usual, revenue per order in range:
summary: Your revenue is above the usual range for this group, and orders are above usual too.
next_step: Look at which offers sold best and keep them available.

Example with revenue below usual, orders in range, revenue per order below usual:
summary: Your revenue is below the usual range for this group, while orders are in range and revenue per order is below usual.
next_step: Review which packages and prices guests are choosing.

Example with all three in range:
summary: Your revenue, orders and revenue per order are all in the usual range for this group.
next_step: Look at which offers sold best and keep them available.

parameters.notes: The AI gets status words only and never sees hotel names or figures. If this call fails, the next step uses the plain template.

nodes.notes: The AI only rewords approved text and never sees hotel names or figures. If this call fails, the next step uses the template.

nodes.name: Summary Format
nodes.notes: No auto-fix on purpose: a bad answer goes to the template, which costs no extra AI call.

nodes.name: Check AI Draft and Build Email
nodes.notes: Code, not another AI, decides if the draft is safe. Any problem means the template is used and a person reviews the email. Needs all hotels to catch other hotels' names.

nodes.name: Needs Human Review?
nodes.notes: Good results with a passing AI draft go straight to the owner. Needs-improvement results and template emails go to a person first.
